source: Saudi Ministry of Health English RSS feed
status: REVIEWED - the three borderline cases were resolved as relevant on 17 September 2026. One open question remains in rubricNotes.

verdicts.relevant: GCC HealthTech news that belongs on the site.
verdicts.not_relevant: Collected by the feed but outside the site's subject.
verdicts.borderline: The rubric does not decide this case. None remain in this set; keep the verdict available for future labelling.

rubricNotes.audience: A reader tracking the GCC HealthTech sector, not only its products. An article earns a place if it tells that reader something they can act on or learn the direction of the sector from.
include: Deployed or announced health technology: digital health, telemedicine, medical robotics, health AI, connected devices.
Sector events and exhibitions in the GCC, because the reader may attend them.
Substantial health infrastructure, investment, and research partnerships, because they signal where the sector is heading.
exclude: Statements of gratitude to national leadership.
rubricNotes.open: Where is the line between an included partnership and an excluded diplomatic MoU? The current set includes the Saudi NIH research MoU but excludes the Portugal and France health-cooperation MoUs. The proposed test is whether the item names concrete subject matter rather than general cooperation, but this has not been confirmed.
